source_task: Image semantic instance and panoptic segmentation
source_evidence: The official CVF paper reports similar state-of-the-art accuracy with a ViT-only encoder design and up to four-times faster prediction for ViT-L.
transfer_interface: Replace the dedicated 3D occupancy decoder with interleaved voxel or tri-plane tokens and mask queries updated inside one shared encoder; keep the view lift and occupancy head as controlled interfaces.
adaptation_hypothesis: Test whether decoder removal and joint token-query refinement preserve thin structures while reducing latency; this is a narrow 3D adaptation hypothesis rather than generic mask-query transfer.
query_problem: encoder-only mask transformer 3D occupancy autonomous driving
query_mechanism: plain transformer segmentation queries BEV semantic occupancy
search_sources: CVF proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;arXiv checked 2026-08-05;;Semantic Scholar checked 2026-08-05;;Crossref checked 2026-08-05;;official GitHub checked 2026-08-05
minimum_test: On one Occ3D validation protocol replace only the decoder; match backbone pretraining resolution schedule and supervision; report mIoU latency peak memory and thin-class IoU over three seeds.
rollback_baseline: The unchanged public occupancy baseline with its original decoder and the same backbone checkpoint.
falsifier: Remove the decoder change or restore the original decoder; if matched accuracy-efficiency Pareto does not improve or thin-object IoU degrades beyond the preset tolerance the transfer claim fails.

source_evidence: The official NeurIPS paper introduces exponential gating plus scalar and matrix memories and reports favorable scaling against Transformers and state-space models; matrix memory is parallelizable during training.
ad_target_task: Streaming BEV or object-query perception memory
transfer_interface: Insert mLSTM as prediction-relevant state after ego-motion alignment of BEV or object queries; define explicit per-scene read write reset detach and sequence-slot rules while leaving the spatial encoder and heads unchanged.
adaptation_hypothesis: Test whether matrix-valued memory stores multiple motion and occlusion modes better than a single previous-BEV buffer without creating train-test state leakage.
query_problem: xLSTM autonomous driving perception BEV occupancy tracking
query_mechanism: extended LSTM 3D object detection autonomous driving
search_sources: NeurIPS proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;ICLR proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;arXiv checked 2026-08-05;;Semantic Scholar checked 2026-08-05;;Google Research publication page checked 2026-08-05
minimum_test: Replace only the temporal memory in a streaming nuScenes detector; audit shuffled scene slots reset and detach; compare one-frame previous-BEV ConvGRU and mLSTM at matched state bytes over three seeds and corruption runs.

transfer_interface: Use feature upsampling before view lifting or BEV fusion while preserving the base foundation encoder.

query_problem: foundation feature upsampling autonomous driving BEV

source_task: Training-free denoising-step caching for video diffusion
source_evidence: The official CVPR paper reports up to 4.41x acceleration on Open-Sora-Plan with a 0.07 percent VBench decrease under its source protocol.
ad_target_task: Accelerating action-conditioned driving video world models
transfer_interface: Insert timestep-embedding-aware cache decisions around repeated UNet or DiT block outputs while keeping action and history conditioning unchanged.
adaptation_hypothesis: Cache only when modulated input differences stay below a calibrated threshold and force recomputation near action changes dynamic actors or rollout boundaries; compare quality and state drift at matched hardware.
query_problem: driving diffusion world model inference latency and deployment cost
query_mechanism: timestep embedding aware cache autonomous driving video denoising
query_synonym: feature reuse fast sampling action conditioned long horizon world model
search_sources: CVF proceedings checked 2026-08-07;;arXiv and web indexes checked 2026-08-07;;OpenAlex/Crossref style indexes partially timed out 2026-08-07;;official TeaCache and Vista repositories checked 2026-08-07;;AAAI and CVPR proceedings checked 2026-08-07
minimum_test: On one fixed Vista-like checkpoint compare no cache uniform cache TeaCache and reduced-step sampling on the same GPU across ordinary clips action switches and multi-round rollouts; report latency memory FVD trajectory difference dynamic-object error and state drift over three seeds.
rollback_baseline: The unmodified full-step sampler plus a simple fixed-interval cache and a matched reduced-step sampler.
falsifier: If TeaCache does not improve wall-clock at matched quality or if action compliance dynamic actors or cross-clip state drift exceed preset tolerances retain it only as a negative control.
